spec_match.rationale: Accurate explainer: Controlled Frame vs iframe/service-worker comparison, IWA-only availability, and the enterprise motivations mirror the ChromeStatus/developer.chrome.com framing of why SecurityInfo lands there.

interactive.rationale: Only the generic 'scenario focus' walkthrough; even a one-line 'ControlledFrame available here? no — IWA-only' probe would give the page a real readout.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises the what/how-it-differs/why-enterprise story; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: The comparison table covers the availability matrix, but nothing demonstrates or probes the non-IWA failure mode it describes.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5076692209106944 alongside the docs and siblings.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's environment assertions (including the SecurityInfo-not-on-Response negative) align with this page's story; nothing asserts the table's claims.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Load verified with screenshots, clean console, and DOM checks on both viewports; there is no feature control to drive on this explainer.

telemetry_health.rationale: Server-injected /public/demo-telemetry.js verified in the served DOM.

design_system.rationale: Shared variables; comparison table styled consistently with the catalogue.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic table, aria-labelledby walkthrough section, aria-live walkthrough output.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured at 360px: the compare-table reaches 402px and its right column is clipped by body overflow-x:hidden.

openQuestions.title: Probe ControlledFrame availability live
openQuestions.detail: Add a small probe ('customElements/ControlledFrame constructor present? running in an IWA?') that honestly reports 'not available — Controlled Frame requires an Isolated Web App' in normal tabs, turning the explainer's central claim into a live readout instead of prose.

openQuestions.title: Make the comparison table scroll on mobile
openQuestions.detail: At 360px the table measures 402px and the last column is cut; wrap in overflow-x:auto.

summary: Solid, accurate context page with good a11y semantics; needs a live availability probe to satisfy the interactivity bar and an overflow wrapper for the comparison table clipped at 360px. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshot + DOM dump) and raw CDP (real click dispatch, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile emulation) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so v145-only API paths were validated on their fallback branches, not the new-API success path. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental (blocked host) and was not counted against any page.
